answer: Each identity locks 25.000 POA and declares the grade band its answer deserves before blind jury grading — the raven check. If the jury grade echoes the declared band, the bond returns untouched; outside it, half is burned, half pays the jury pool, and three misses in a row suspend the identity for six epochs. A farm running 1.000 fakes risks 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA on guesses it cannot calibrate, while an honest agent risks 25.000 once and knows its own work. A miss is stamped in umber, and an honest agent can still lose bond when a harsh jury disagrees with a fair self-grade.
